jobs.employer_name: International Max Planck Research School for Molecules of Life
jobs.description:
We welcome applications via our website from 25 August - 07 October 2026.

The International Max Planck Research School for Molecules of Life (IMPRS-ML) offers fully funded PhD student positions in the areas of biochemistry, structural biology, biophysics, cell biology, systems biology, and computational biology. We are looking for outstanding graduates from all over the world to join our network of passionate young scientists in Munich. CURRICULUM & TRAINING
IMPRS-ML offers high-level scientific training in a dynamic and international research environment with state-of-the-art facilities to doctoral researchers aiming for successful careers in science. Our comprehensive curriculum allows our students to tailor their learning to their interests, requiring them to earn 25-30 ECTS through various activities. Seminars, summer schools, retreats, elective courses, and participation in international conferences supplement their laboratory work.

JOIN OUR COMMUNITY
The strongest asset of our graduate program is our vivid and international research community. IMPRS-ML brings together two renowned Max Planck Institutes, the Max Planck Institute of Biochemistry (MPIB) and the Max Planck Institute for Biological Intelligence (MPI-BI), as well as two leading partner universities, the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU) and the Technische Universität München (TUM), to deliver first-class training for the world’s most promising young scientists. Our graduate school comprises more than 250 PhD students from 40+ countries as well as 35+ distinguished and internationally recognised faculty members.
Applicants should hold an MSc (or equivalent degree) with a strong background in biological sciences, biochemistry, biophysics, biotechnology or a related discipline.
Outstanding applicants with a 4-years BSc hons (or equivalent degree) may be eligible to apply depending on the degree awarding country.

For more information, eligibility criteria and online application please visit our website:  https://imprs-ml.mpg.de/
A structured PhD program created by Munich-based Max Planck Institutes and Universities with English as the main language

Individual supervision and mentoring by world-leading scientists

Paid PhD positions and full funding for international and German students, with no tuition fees and additional funding for scientific training
An individual career development program, a wide range of methodology courses and soft skills workshops

Administrative support and guidance for national and international students

Excellent career opportunities in a thriving international research community

jobs.occupation: Batteries und Sub-Station Delivery Project Manager and Portfolio Expert (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Batterietechnik)
jobs.description:
E.ON Energy Projects GmbH (EEP) designs, finances, builds, operates and optimises decentralised, large-scale power generation plants for industrial customers. Since 2000, we realised projects of more than 1 gigawatt across Europe. With our bespoke integrated solutions, we drive decarbonisation and digitalisation in the energy-intensive industries.
At E.ON diversity matters. We welcome all people and are convinced that differences make us stronger. Become part of our inclusive and diverse company culture! To create equal opportunities for everyone we offer our positions in full- or part-time.
Ready to become a Playmaker of the energy transition? Join our team in München and apply online as Batteries und Sub-Station Delivery Project Manager and Portfolio Expert (f/m/d). Are you brave enough to drive progress and forge new paths? Let’s make it work and create real impact together. We can’t wait to meet you! It’s on us, to make new energy work.

Responsibilities

- This role operates within a dual reporting structure, reporting to the Implementation Department at E.ON Energy Projects GmbH and to the CTO-led Solutions Portfolio department within the central function of E.ON Energy Infrastructure Solutions (EIS).
- Delivery of large-scale Batteries and sub-station CAPEX projects across Europe, starting in the development phase through to handover to operations, with responsibility for safety, scope, cost, timeline, performance, and quality
- Overall leadership of an integrated project team with subject-matter experts to drive the development and execution of the projects, covering project management, contract and risk management, project controls, permitting, engineering, construction, commissioning, procurement, and claim management, as well as internal and external stakeholder management
- Support the International Batteries Pipeline Manager in applying a structured portfolio management approach, by proactively coordinating with other project managers across regions to identify risks, gaps, and interdependencies
- Provide technical and delivery assurance across multiple BESS projects, ensuring alignment on scope, quality, schedule, and budget; review and challenge project plans and critical paths, identify risks early, and define corrective actions
- Validate engineering designs, studies, and commissioning strategies to ensure technically robust and cost-efficient solutions, and engage hands-on in resolving critical technical and delivery issues
- Support the development of standardisation, best practices, and lessons learned across the portfolio, building on existing capabilities within the Group
Requirements
- Degree in electrical engineering or related field, with senior-level BESS and/or power infrastructure project delivery experience, ideally including integrated BESS and substation projects
- Proven experience in managing multiple projects in parallel, with a structured approach to project management and project controls
- Proven cross-country stakeholder coordination, communication, and influence across project teams, suppliers, EPC partners, and other stakeholders
- Strong BESS technical expertise
- Solid understanding of BESS cost drivers and EPC delivery models, with commercial, hands-on, and continuous improvement mindset
- Fluent in German and English (C1); Willingness to travel (20-40%)
Benefits
- High flexibility: Make work fit your personal life with our hybrid working model, flexible hours, and job-sharing options
- More freedom: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave plus extra days off, and find your balance with options like a 4.5-day week, a sabbatical, extra time, or extra pay
- Workation included: Make Europe your office and work up to 20 days per year from inspiring locations across the EU
- Corporate benefits: Secure your future with benefits including company pension schemes, our share programme, a range of insurance packages, and much more
- Culture of innovation: Share your ideas and unleash creativity in a collaborative, interdisciplinary environment with flat hierarchies
- Family support: Manage family life – from paid family start leave, childcare and holiday programs, to daily assistance for family members
- Modern workplace: Enjoy a multifunctional workspace that combines cutting-edge digital technology with ergonomic comfort for productivity and collaboration
- Strong team spirit: Celebrate successes and connect with colleagues at our company and team events
- Personal growth: Unlock your potential through continuous learning, diverse development opportunities, and personalized training or mentoring
- Holistic health: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with our sports, fitness, wellness, nutrition, meditation, physiotherapy, and preventive healthcare offerings
- Individual mobility: Travel your way with flexible options such as car and bike leasing, or a subsidised Deutschlandticket for public transport
- Culinary offering: Enjoy fresh, balanced meals, snacks, and drinks at many office locations with our subsidised canteen

Do you have questions?
For further information please contact Kyra Temma, kyra.temma@eon.com. Are you already convinced that this is the next step in your career? If yes, we would be happy if you would register and apply online (Job ID 246062). Just a quick note: Please only use our official application portal to apply. Unfortunately, we can't consider applications sent via email. We really appreciate your understanding!

jobs.description:
Technical Assistant (m/f/d) in Translational Animal Biotechnology

Full- and Part-time | terminated (12 months) | TUM Hospital

Animal models of human disease are essential for studying disease pathogenesis and developing novel therapeutic approaches. To support the generation of transgenic large-animal models for cardiovascular research, we are seeking a technical assistant to contribute to laboratory-based research activities. 

Your responsibilities:

- Application of laboratory methods relevant to somatic cell cloning (cell sorting, microinjection, SCNT, gene targeted techniques, embryo cultivation) 
- Documentation of work e.g. in accordance with biosafety requirements
- Maintenance and upkeep of laboratory equipment
- Supporting lab management (e.g. procurement and ordering of laboratory supplies)
- Supervising students and apprentices

Your profile:

- Completed training as a biological technical assistant (BTA) or a bachelor's degree (B.Sc.) in biology
- Several years of hands-on experience in embryological techniques relevant to somatic cell nuclear transfer (SCNT) is an essential requirement for this position.
- Solid practical experience in molecular biology
- Careful and complete documentation of experiments.
- Strong English skills
- Precision, dedication, and teamwork are second nature to you.

We offer you:

- An exciting and intellectually stimulating position in a highly interdisciplinary and international environment 
- EGYM well pass, corporate benefits and discounts (e.g. Käfer), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers, company bike

- Self-realization through a varied and technically demanding job with interdisciplinary cooperation between various departments of the TUM Klinikum

We look forward to meeting you!

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

We are looking for an IT Security Specialist to define security standards for two major data infrastructure projects in the Heidelberg-Mannheim region: (1) The Data Space Project (https://www.health-life-sciences.de/dataspace/)  of the Health + Life Science Alliance (http://www.health-life-sciences.de/) has recently been launched to develop a trusted research environment (TRE) for seven leading life sciences and biomedical research institutions in the Heidelberg-Mannheim region. (2) The German Human Genome-Phenome Archive (GHGA) (https://www.ghga.de/de/)  is part of the national program for research data infrastructures (NFDI) (https://www.nfdi.de/)  and has established a secure national omics data infrastructure, enabling the secondary use of human omics data in research.

These infrastructures are supporting the bioinformatics community with software tools for secure data/metadata storage, interactive data portals with data visualization, and streamlined data deposition and acquisition solutions. Prof. Oliver Stegle is coordinating GHGA at the DKFZ and representing the Data Space project for the DKFZ in close collaboration with the other Health + Life Science Alliance member institutions Heidelberg University, European Molecular Biology Laboratory (EMBL), Central Institute of Mental Health, Max Planck Institute for Medical Research, Heidelberg University Hospital and University Hospital Mannheim.

In order to develop the Data Space Trusted Research Environment (TRE) and the GHGA platform into a state-of-the-art infrastructure for the secure handling and analysis of genome data, we are seeking with immediate effect an IT Security Specialist.

Job description:

We are looking for a team member with substantial experience in information security and risk governance. Your role will be instrumental in technical and organizational decision-making for the Data Space and GHGA projects and will ensure compliance with modern standards for both infrastructures. You will be part of two tightly connected teams spanning cloud engineers, data stewards and interdisciplinary researchers with the joint mission of enabling the secure sharing of sensitive biomedical data for the scientific research community. You will have a diverse set of tasks, shaping the IT infrastructure of the Data Space TRE from the start, while also managing the IT security for the operation of the established GHGA Portal and upcoming new functionalities. Your expertise will help ensure the safe operation of the Data Space TRE and GHGA while also contributing to the development of standards in Germany and supporting their role in international efforts.

Your responsibilities :

- Analysis and documentation of current operations with respect to IT security, identifying gaps and supporting continuous improvement
- Implementation and maintenance of a framework for risk and asset management, utilizing modern tools and standards
- Creation and maintenance of an Information Security Management System (ISMS)
- Implementation and maintenance of a program for security awareness that works across multiple communication channels
- Regular monitoring of risks through third-party interactors, such as used infrastructures or sub-contractors
- Provision of information security guidance for IT projects, including the evaluation and recommendation of technical controls
- Coordination of interaction with external expertise on legal and technical IT security topics

Your Profile:

Essential Expertise:

- Proven experience with core information security frameworks (BSI IT-Grundschutz, ISO 27001) and risk management methodologies
- Hands-on background in developing and implementing risk-mitigation plans, security policies, processes, and technical controls
- Solid understanding of GDPR compliance requirements and IT infrastructure fundamentals (e.g., networking, server roles, system architecture)
- Fluency in German and English to articulate technical requirements clearly and collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners
- Demonstrated project management skills, with the ability to work independently, solve problems creatively, and drive initiatives to completion

Advantageous Qualifications:

- Knowledge of cloud security guardrails in multi-account environments (e.g., IAM, SCP, centralized logging, encryption, network isolation)
- CISSP certification or equivalent advanced security credential

We Offer

-  Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
-  30 days of vacation per year
-  Flexible working hours
-  Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
-  Possibility of mobile work and part-time work
-  Family-friendly working environment
-  Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
-  Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents
-  Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

jobs.occupation: Senior Developer (f/m/d) for SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning - eSPP and PP/DS (ERP-Anwendungsentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. 
 
What you’ll do: 

Are you ready to take a senior engineering role in shaping mission-critical planning solutions at the heart of the world’s leading enterprise software company? This is an opportunity to contribute to SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning, with a focus on both SAP Extended Service Parts Planning (eSPP) and Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS). Together, these solutions help customers plan complex supply chains, optimize service levels, production resources, material availability, and operational execution across industries. 

You will work on business-critical planning capabilities used by customers with large service parts, manufacturing, warehouse, dealer, and distribution networks. Our roadmap includes modern SAP Fiori user experiences, advanced planning algorithms, forecasting, inventory planning, detailed scheduling, simulation, analytics, integration with SAP S/4HANA capabilities such as aATP, and the next wave of AI-assisted planning, optimization, and navigation. 

As a Senior Developer in our SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning team, you will: 

- Own the design, implementation, testing, and delivery of complex features across eSPP and PP/DS, with responsibility for quality, maintainability, performance, and long-term product standard compliance. 
- Apply your strong C++ background to analyze and evolve planning and optimization-related components, while also working with SAP technologies such as ABAP, SAP Fiori, CDS views, RAP, SQL, and SAP S/4HANA integration patterns. 
- Contribute to capabilities for service parts planning, production planning, detailed scheduling, forecasting, inventory planning, stocking and destocking decisions, simulation, mass maintenance, analytics, and integration with adjacent SAP solutions. 
- Drive technical concepts, architectural improvements, refactoring, automated tests, code reviews, root-cause analysis, and defect prevention for mission-critical private cloud products. 
- Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, quality engineers, product management, and development colleagues across locations to translate customer and roadmap requirements into reliable, scalable, and user-oriented solutions. 
- Act as a technical role model for less experienced developers by sharing knowledge, reviewing designs and code, and helping the team continuously improve engineering practices. 
- Help shape the next generation of planning capabilities, including AI-assisted planning experiences, Joule-based contextual assistance, embedded analytics, and modern SAP Fiori user experiences. 
 
What you bring: 
- A good to excellent university degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Natural Sciences, or a related field.

Job Description

About Us

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Through our PPD® clinical research services, we support clinical trials in more than 100 countries, delivering laboratory, digital and decentralized solutions that help bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Our global Clinical Operations teams provide end-to-end clinical trial support — from study start-up through close-out — across commercial and government-sponsored studies.

Why Join Thermo Fisher Scientific / PPD?

- Work on high-quality, global clinical trials across diverse therapeutic areas
- Be part of a stable, well-established organization with long-term career opportunities
- Strong collaboration with experienced CTMs and project teams
- Clear development pathways (e.g., Senior CRA, Lead CRA, CTM)
- Flexible working models that support work-life balance
- Permanent employment
- Full-time (40 hours/week) or Part-time (32 hours/week) options available

About the Role

This position is for experienced Clinical Research Associates with 2+ years of independent monitoring experience. You will manage clinical trial sites across Germany, ensuring studies are conducted in compliance with the protocol, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, and company SOPs.

You’ll work autonomously, partner closely with investigative sites, and collaborate with project teams to deliver high-quality, inspection-ready clinical trials.

What You’ll Do

- Perform site monitoring activities (on-site and remote) using a risk-based monitoring approach
- Ensure protocol, ICH-GCP, regulatory, and SOP compliance at investigator sites
- Conduct SDR, SDV, CRF review, and investigational product accountability
- Identify, document, escalate, and follow up on issues through resolution, applying root cause analysis and CAPA principles
- Maintain audit and inspection readiness at all assigned sites
- Build strong, collaborative relationships with investigators and site staff
- Document monitoring activities in timely, high-quality reports and follow-up letters
- Maintain ongoing communication with sites between visits to support issue resolution and data quality
- Ensure study systems (e.g., CTMS) are updated according to study conventions
- Provide trial status updates and metrics to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM)
- Support study start-up, investigator identification, site initiation, and study close-out activities as assigned
- Participate in investigator meetings, audits, inspections, and project team meetings as required

Additional responsibilities may include supporting process improvement initiatives, mentoring activities, or project-specific tasks aligned with experience.

A Day in the Life

- Review site metrics and prioritize monitoring activities based on risk
- Conduct on-site or remote monitoring visits
- Partner with sites to resolve findings and improve processes
- Collaborate with CTMs and project teams to keep studies on track and inspection-ready
- Complete documentation, system updates, and administrative tasks

Education & Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field or equivalent qualification
- Minimum 2+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate / Monitor
- Valid driver’s license
- Full right to work in Germany
- Fluency in German and English (C1 level) – interviews will be conducted in German

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong clinical monitoring skills with hands-on RBM experience
- Excellent understanding and application of ICH-GCP and applicable regulations
- Solid therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
- Well-developed critical thinking, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with medical professionals
- High attention to detail and strong organizational skills
- Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to cross-functional teams
- Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic project environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn clinical systems (e.g., CTMS)

Locations: Home-based or hybrid anywhere in Germany
FTE: Full-time (40 hrs/week) or Part-time 80% (32 hrs/week)
Contract: Permanent
Travel: Approximately 50–75% (study-dependent)

Purpose of your Job

Are you looking for a career in research & development of biopharmaceuticals or in general in the pharmaceutical industry?
Then join Coriolis Pharma and contribute with state-of-the-art capillary electrophoresis analytics to our formulations and lyophilization processes for biopharmaceutical drugs!
You will join a highly motivated, interdisciplinary team performing contract research and development for customers in the (bio) pharmaceutical industry worldwide.
You will be a vital part of our contract research organization – where you will support & learn from our scientific operations teams – to enable our clients in their journey of developing innovative drugs.

Your Responsibility

As Senior Scientist you are - together with the project team - responsible for the successful development and execution of capillary electrophoresis (CE) analysis for our customers worldwide.  

- Responsible—as subject matter expert—for supporting client project acquisition and execution with expertise to ensure high-quality services.
- Accountable for the electrophoretic characterization of biopharmaceutical molecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids) within client projects, including the de novo development of CE methods and the interpretation of data in context with other analytical approaches (such as LC-MS or LC-IEX).
- Maintain cutting-edge scientific knowledge in CE and related areas and drive CE innovation to meet evolving business needs, including new business areas and novel molecular modalities.
- Work cooperatively across Coriolis teams (e.g., business development, finance, technical support team) to ensure seamless collaboration with all operational groups during client project execution.

What you need to succeed

- University degree in analytical chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, (bio)chemistry, or a related field; a PhD related to separation sciences—ideally focused on CE applications / method development and associated areas—is preferred
- Minimum 5 years of industry experience (with PhD in a relevant field) or 9 years (without PhD) with in-depth knowledge of biopharmaceutical characterization by CE (CE-SDS, CZE, cIEF) using UV, PDA, LIF, or FLD detection
- Several years of hands-on experience with CE instruments from different vendors (e.g., Sciex, BioTechne/ProteinSimple, Agilent, etc.)
- Proven experience in developing, transferring, and troubleshooting CE (and associated) analytical methods in an industry setting, including both R&D and GMP environments
- Demonstrated project management skills, including resource management, multitasking, prioritization, and risk management
- Strong lateral leadership capabilities, with leading by example as a natural approach
- Hands-on, proactive mindset with openness to new ideas and tasks; a can-do attitude is essential
- Team-oriented personality with strong motivational and interpersonal skills
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Job responsibilities:

- This role requires working on-site exclusively, with no other working option available.

- A strong and open communication skills is essential.

- Experience in PCR, qPCR and Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS)-based analysis is advantageous.
- Very good knowledge of German and English language, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Chinese will be an added advantage.

jobs.occupation: Flight Test Ground Station Systems Architect (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the Flight Test Ground Station Germany Team Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Flight Test Ground Station Systems Architect (m/w/d)

** Your location**

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

** Our Benefits for You**

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

** Your tasks and responsibilities**

As a Systems & Software Architect for the Flight Test Ground Station (FTGS)

- you will lead the end-to-end architectural lifecycle for a complex suite of flight test tools, including FTGS-Core, FIDA, and various Add-On tools.
- you will be responsible for defining and documenting comprehensive system requirements, balancing operational needs, technical constraints, and stringent regulatory requirements.
- your core mission involves developing and iterating robust architectures encompassing hardware, software, and network infrastructure.
- Utilizing established architectural patterns and best practices, you will design modular, scalable systems and produce high-quality design specifications, interface definitions, and technical documentation.
- You will play a decisive role in evaluating and selecting the technologies and components necessary for successful system implementation, ensuring seamless interoperability and compatibility between various subsystems and external interfaces.
- Beyond design, you will drive technical excellence by establishing development best practices, conducting detailed design studies, and overseeing validation and verification (V&V) strategies. You will actively support the system integration process and contribute to the creation of test strategies to validate architecture and performance.
- A key aspect of this role is cross-functional leadership within an Integrated Product Team (IPT). You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams—including software, hardware, test, and operations engineers—to resolve complex technical challenges.
- By leading "tiger teams" to address critical issues and facilitating continuous improvement through rigorous retrospectives, you will ensure long-term technical consistency.
- Furthermore, you will remain at the forefront of the industry by monitoring emerging technologies and trends in flight test and ground station systems, ensuring the FTGS toolchain remains cutting-edge and future-proof.

** Desired skills and qualifications**

- Education: Completed university degree (Master’s or Diploma) in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science
- Professional Experience: Several years of professional experience in system architecture or the design of complex technical systems, ideally within the Aerospace or Defense sectors.
- Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of Flight Test Ground Station systems, telemetry, data processing, and data analysis.
- Technical Proficiency:
- Advanced expertise in C++ development and software design patterns.
- Strong command of Linux environments and system administration.
- Proven experience with various software/hardware architectures and network protocols.
- Expertise in defining system requirements and creating architectural models (e.g., UML, SysML).
- Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop innovative, scalable solutions.
- Soft Skills: Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to thrive in a multidisciplinary, international environment.
- Languages: Fluency in both German and English (written and spoken) is mandatory.
- Travel: Willingness to undertake occasional business travel.
- Preferred: Practical experience in flight test analysis is advantageous.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
